  "memo":"R03 holds: the US-issued card was used from a Nigerian IP and CVV failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no other rule holds. Household exceptions are inapplicable, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Travel with a CVV entry error is the strongest benign explanation, but passing AVS does not establish authorization. With no checks completed, recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), implemented as a hold with id_check before shipment. That check establishes card and account identity; contact is not required. Decline and escalation are not permitted on the current evidence. No installments were due, so non-payment provides no basis for action."
